body:
i resolve to love you
beyond boundaries
not inflicting limitations
without ever having to
think twice before giving you
all that was ever mine
to find the love in yours eyes
that resides within the depths of my heart
i would illuminate the sky
and align the stars to spell your name
so that whenever you look up at the sky
you ll be certain that iam looking over you
in all my capacity, at the edge of that spell
whether we are together or not 4
that love will still remain.
author: Mohit Yenugwar
